summary: A Senate panel advanced a bipartisan bill to prohibit the Education Department from transferring its key operations to other agencies.

title: Scam Artists Are Posing as IRS Agents to Drain Crypto Wallets
title_cn: 骗子冒充国税局特工来榨干加密钱包
summary: Scammers are impersonating the IRS to drain crypto accounts and steal identities, using official-looking letters to bypass digital defenses, the agency’s criminal investigation unit warned.
